newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Fore raise to buy at DMG.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Fore raise to buy at DMG.

text.p: - Fore Systems Inc's stock was raised to "buy" from "accumulate" on Wednesday at DMG Technology Group because of the expansion plans of a major customers, said analyst Noel Lindsey.
- Worldcom Inc said Wednesday it plans to spend $300 million to upgrade its computer network infrastructure. Fore, a major supplier, should benefit from the expansion, Lindsey said.
- "I've added $30 million to my revenue estimate, although it's probably conservative," he said.
